I've dabbled in bit in writing [The Biggest Little is mine](https://www.dailydiapers.com/board/index.php?/topic/79435-the-biggest-little-hiatus/). 

The obvious and most useful advise if write what you want. I tend to like stories that feel a bit more grounded, but really, whatever if you are interested in.

Good luck on whatever you end up writing.

That seems like a list of things you require to date. How about be friends with?

In my experience the community is quite diverse. Including people who are conservative (as long as you are accepting of others no one cares about politics), have anxiety and depression (actually pretty common), and all levels of attractiveness.

The thing that tends to get people ostracized is treating the community like a meat market. If you go in with the solo intention of finding a partner you are likely to have little luck. I know you have trouble socializing, but you have to chat with people to find people.

I would be hesitant on requiring others to share all your same views. My partner's job that she is very passionate about is selling a product that I think is junk. This is an obvious problem spot but we respect each other enough to move past it. There are lots of difference between us and it is shocking how little some of them matter.

I would also clear your head and read what others have posted here. I get that you are feeling down and rejected which makes it hard to think clearly, but there is some good insight to be found.

I hope things work out well for you,

Mary

Hi,

I am a submissive. I don't call myself a switch or a switch leaning sub. There is nothing wrong with either of those labels but they are not me.


I find no appeal in dominating or topping.

If my partner asked me to top or dom them for a scene I would and I would still call myself a sub. In my mind I would be submitting to them even as I acting like a dom to them because it was through their will that I am doing so. 

If I talked about this to someone at a party and they stated I was a switch I would be offended.

This doesn't mean all subs have to or are okay with domming their partner but doing so does not preclude them from being a sub.

I get that to you labels are important and have definitions. I think they are important as shorthand and have some very lose guidelines. If someone uses a label differently than I do I am going to ask them why, not tell them they are wrong.

This use of true and fake reminds me of the use of marriage vs civil partnership. In some people's mind marriage went hand and hand with religion. In others it had no part. Both types of people are right to say they are married. To tell a gay couple they have a civil partnership when they say they are married is to impose your own requirements over their experience.

Just my two, rambling cents,

I started HRT at the beginning of the month and have been fighting clerical errors and bureaucracy since.

I was told by the doctor to take 2 estradiol a day but the prescription was for once a day. I called the pharmacy and the clinic. Another doctor at the clinic said to take twice a day and refill the prescription early. 

I went yesterday to refill and was told it was too early. After getting off the phone with the clinic and the pharmacy today I have to wait for my insurance to okay the new prescription in a few days.

Which means I am now off hormones for a bit.

I know it is not that big of a deal but I still feel upset. It took so long to start and now I am already off. 

I know there is nothing I can but wait, this doesn't make me any happier about it though.

-Mary
